race.description: Muswellbrook Steel Supplies Tradies Day 27 Nov Hcp (C1)
race.comment: AMAJICSTAR (2) justified the good support on debut with a comprehensive on-pace victory as fav over 900m at Newcastle in fast time. Gets Smyth's claim again and has the upside to keep the winning momentum going. CITY GOLD SPEED (8) doesn't win out of turn, but recent runs have been full of merit. Dropped on them late from midfield with a narrow fourth over this trip at Taree. Gets the weight drop and stays in the calculations from the good gate. MR CORNSTAR (3) tongue-tie goes on after he got off the mark at start eight with a tough win over this course and distance. Drawn out for this and place preferred. FROSTISEN (1)showed potential in her first prep and returns in a winnable race. Fitted with the two searching 1000m trials and maps well from the draw.
